purpose: Authoritative product definition, scope boundary, target use case, capabilities, exclusions, and product principles.

authority.principle: Implementation must serve the defined V4SH product. New product capabilities must not be introduced merely because they are technically possible.

identity.name: V4SH
identity.name_rule: The numeral 4 in V4SH is intentional and permanent unless the product specification is explicitly changed.

problem.context: Crowded college festivals can have unreliable mobile internet and payment friction.
problem.core_problem: Users need a simple way to initiate real UPI payments through existing payment rails without requiring stalls to install or change their payment setup.

core_promise.statement: V4SH provides a lightweight interface for initiating payments through existing UPI/USSD rails.
principles: Make payment uncertainty explicit rather than pretending a payment succeeded.

target_environment.primary: College festivals and other crowded event environments.
constraints: Cellular/mobile network availability may still be required for the underlying payment communication.
Users may encounter standard UPI QR codes at stalls.
Multiple SIM devices may require an explicit payment-SIM choice.

pay.description: Initiate a payment through the supported existing payment rail.

scan_qr.description: Scan standard UPI QR codes and use parsed payment details to prepare a payment.

receive.description: Help the user receive payments through their existing UPI account.

transactions.description: Show local V4SH records of payments initiated through V4SH.

profile.description: Provide payment-account, security/privacy, help/support, about, and logout areas.

merchant_model.principle: A stall should be able to continue using its existing UPI payment setup.

payment_model.unknown_definition: Payment may have been initiated but final outcome cannot be determined.
payment_model.cancelled_definition: User stopped the flow before payment initiation.

connectivity_model.important_distinction: Mobile network availability is not the same thing as payment success or payment readiness.

first_time_setup.principle: Independent prerequisites should be represented independently rather than hidden behind a false single readiness claim.

scope_in: Receive-money information using the user's existing UPI identity.
Security and privacy controls that are actually implemented.
trust_principles: Never claim success without definitive confirmation.
Never label an uncertain payment as failed merely because the app timed out.
Never encourage a second payment when the first payment may already have been initiated.
Never claim V4SH cancelled a bank/UPI transaction when it only stopped waiting.
Never present local V4SH history as a complete bank statement.
Never make security or privacy claims that are not implemented.
product_principles: Existing payment rails over new payment infrastructure.

implementation_boundary.rule: If a proposed feature conflicts with these frozen boundaries, flag the conflict before implementation rather than silently expanding scope.
